events.title: U.S. Constitution Ratified by New Hampshire
events.description: New Hampshire became the ninth state to ratify the United States Constitution, providing the two-thirds majority required for it to take effect among the ratifying states.
events.significance: This ratification made the Constitution operative and established the framework for the federal government of the United States, which continues to govern the nation today.

events.title: Accession of Richard II of England
events.description: Richard II became King of England at the age of ten following the death of his grandfather, Edward III, on this date. His reign was marked by the Peasants' Revolt of 1381 and ongoing conflicts with the nobility.
events.significance: His reign ended in deposition in 1399, which led to the Lancastrian dynasty and set the stage for the later Wars of the Roses.

events.title: Columbia Records Introduces the Long-Playing Record
events.description: At a press event in New York City, Columbia Records unveiled the 33⅓ rpm microgroove LP record, developed by a team led by Peter Goldmark.
events.significance: The LP format revolutionized the music industry by allowing about 20 minutes of music per side, and it became the dominant album format for decades.

events.title: John Hinckley Jr. Found Not Guilty by Reason of Insanity
events.description: A federal jury in Washington, D.C., found John Hinckley Jr. not guilty by reason of insanity for his 1981 attempted assassination of President Ronald Reagan.
events.significance: The verdict provoked public outrage and led Congress and many states to reform the insanity defense, including the Insanity Defense Reform Act of 1984.

events.title: Birth of Benazir Bhutto
events.description: Benazir Bhutto was born in Karachi, Pakistan. She became the first woman to lead a democratic government in a Muslim-majority country when she was elected Prime Minister of Pakistan in 1988.
events.significance: She was a landmark figure for women in politics and a leading voice for democracy in Pakistan until her assassination in December 2007.
